doc: What the towns' people and the guards of Norrath say of their world's own story (the user, 2026-11-10: "Let's add more lines, the NPCs talk about random eqoa lore (remember this is before EQ1 lorewise)"): the lore set of tools/seed_town_dialog.py (--set lore; table npcdialog, source lore, logged in npcdialog_lore_seed). EverQuest Online Adventures is set about five hundred years before EverQuest: the continent is Tunaria, and nothing of EverQuest's own day is spoken of. No lore is invented: every line's note names the facts it rests on by their ids in tools/dialog/LORE-FACTS.md, which gives each fact's source and the source's own words; a line whose fact was in no source was left out. Blocks and fields as town_lines.json's (town, role, mood, race the listener's, sex), and speaker_race (a race's own voice wherever it stands; with away, only as a guest away from its own towns). A line is {line, note}. Trolls and ogres say no common line (no town, no race), so their lore is in their towns' and their races' blocks, in their speech. In a line %p is the listener's name, %r its race, %c its class, %t the town, %n the speaker. tools/seed_town_dialog_lore_test.py holds the file to its rules (a note on every line, the client's box, no name of EverQuest's day, no two lines alike).

say.line: Neriak is the next country north. We wave at the dark elves when they pass. They never wave back.

say.line: The Cracktooth orcs are a small clan, they say. They do not look small from behind a pie safe.
say.note: FREE-5: The Cracktooth are a small clan of orcs that raids the eastern commonlands near Freeport; they...

say.line: West of us is the Green Rift, with Combine ruins in it older than anybody's grandmother. A House of Neriak is digging there.
say.note: BOB-1, LAND-25, NER-3: The halflings of Bobble-by-Water live near Nektulos Forest: Neriak's country is the zone north...

say.line: There are only a few halfling hamlets in all Tunaria. We are one. Merry-by-Water is another. We exchange recipes and insults.
say.note: VALE-2: Merry-by-Water is one of the few halfling hamlets of Tunaria, on the shore of the northern...

say.line: Hodstock is south of here. They dislike strangers. We have been neighbors for years and they still call us strangers.
say.note: FREE-6, BOB-1: Temby is a small smuggling village just north of Freeport; Hodstock is a village of xenophobic...

say.line: Bristlebane put halflings out of the way of trouble. Somebody moved the trouble closer. We have complained.
say.note: GODS-11: Fizzlethorpe Bristlebane, the King of Thieves, came fashionably late, joined Brell and...

say.line: Cracktooth orcs lurk about the village. Raise a shout if you see one. Raise two if it sees you.
say.note: FREE-5: The Cracktooth are a small clan of orcs that raids the eastern commonlands near Freeport; they...

say.line: This castle trains warriors, and it guards the north from invasion. Both duties are older than anyone serving here.
say.note: LIGHT-1: Castle Lightwolf, in the North Wilderlands, is a training center for warriors and is charged...

say.line: Slay a beast in the ice castle of Lady Vox, up in Permafrost, and you will find a warmer welcome within these walls.
say.note: LIGHT-2: The castle trusts those who slay the beasts of Lady Vox's castle in Permafrost; ambassadors...

say.line: Ambassadors keep rooms in our towers. Each one watches the others. We watch all of them.
say.note: LIGHT-2: The castle trusts those who slay the beasts of Lady Vox's castle in Permafrost; ambassadors...

say.line: The Anu have their village north of the Wilderlands. Hard folk. They trust a giant-killer and nobody else.
say.note: LIGHT-3, HAL-2: The village of the Anu lies north of the castle's Wilderlands, the northern Unkempt west of...

say.line: West of us the Unkempt begins. The castle helps keep its northern edge. Who asked that of us is not a thing we discuss.
say.note: LIGHT-3, WERE-6: The village of the Anu lies north of the castle's Wilderlands, the northern Unkempt west of...

say.line: Three generations of Lightwolfs have kept this castle. And its secrets. Do not ask which is the heavier burden.
say.note: WERE-6: For three generations the lords of Castle Lightwolf have kept their lycanthropy secret from all...

say.line: The wolves that howl outside our walls are not ours. Masterless things. The moon makes fools of them.
say.note: WERE-7: Wolfweres have no human form and no mastery of themselves; when the moon of Drinal is full they...

say.line: We are charged with guarding the north. Orc, giant or goblin, the castle means to stop it here.
say.note: LIGHT-1: Castle Lightwolf, in the North Wilderlands, is a training center for warriors and is charged...

say.line: Werewolves prowl the country round the castle. Stay on the road at night. If you leave it, do not run. They like it when you run.
say.note: LIGHT-1, WERE-7: Castle Lightwolf, in the North Wilderlands, is a training center for warriors and is charged...

say.line: The self-righteous of Tunaria drove us out of their cities. Dark Solace took us in. We remember both.
say.note: SOLACE-1: Dark Solace is a safe sanctuary offered to every evil humanoid persecuted by the self-righteous...

say.line: Troll, ogre, dark elf, or a human with the wrong god: all are safe here. It is the only promise this town makes.
say.note: SOLACE-1: Dark Solace is a safe sanctuary offered to every evil humanoid persecuted by the self-righteous...

say.line: Pay no mind to the Disciples of Plague at the front of town. They do not think. They only serve.
say.note: SOLACE-1: Dark Solace is a safe sanctuary offered to every evil humanoid persecuted by the self-righteous...

say.line: West of the crossroads is Urglunt's Wall, with cyclops at its gate. East, the centaurs. Neither likes our kind. Nobody does.
say.note: SOLACE-2, LAND-18: Urglunt's Wall lies west of Dark Solace's crossroads, the valley of the centaurs east of them...

say.line: Widow's Peak rises south of us. Birdmen keep it. They look down on everyone, which at least is fair.
say.note: SOLACE-2, BLACK-2: Urglunt's Wall lies west of Dark Solace's crossroads, the valley of the centaurs east of them...

say.line: Forkwatch lies north up the road. Good honest folk. That is why we stay down here.
say.note: FORK-2: The Salt Mine lies east of Forkwatch, held by the Blackscourge river pirates; the South...

say.line: Some pray to the Plague King. In the cities his faithful must hide their temples. Here nobody is made to hide.
say.note: PLAGUE-3: Bertoxxulous is the Plague King, Lord of Decay; a hidden temple of his stands even in...

say.line: This is a sanctuary. Whatever you did out there, you did not do it here. Keep it so.
say.note: SOLACE-1: Dark Solace is a safe sanctuary offered to every evil humanoid persecuted by the self-righteous...

say.line: They call this country Jared's Blight. Jared is an enchanter, one of the most powerful in Tunaria. The name tells you how he uses it.
say.note: DARV-1: Darvar Manor stands in the land called Jared's Blight; Jared is one of Tunaria's most powerful...

say.line: Jared has a tower. The master does not call on him. Nobody calls on Jared twice.
say.note: DARV-1: Darvar Manor stands in the land called Jared's Blight; Jared is one of Tunaria's most powerful...

say.line: The Bandit Hills lie just east. The name is not a jest. The manor pays its guards well for a reason.
say.note: DARV-2: The Bandit Hills lie east of the manor's land, the ruins of Al'Karad west of it and Blackburrow...

say.line: West of here are the ruins of Al'Karad. When Al'Karad was defeated, Takish'Hiz was doomed. Elves still flinch at the name.
say.note: DARV-2, TOMB-4: The Bandit Hills lie east of the manor's land, the ruins of Al'Karad west of it and Blackburrow...

say.line: The Black Swan Inn is the first roof on the road south. If the manor will not have you, the Swan will.
say.note: DARV-2: The Bandit Hills lie east of the manor's land, the ruins of Al'Karad west of it and Blackburrow...

say.line: A barrow of cultists lies on the river toward Forkwatch. Thenon the Wise, they named it for. He cannot have been very.
say.note: DARV-3: A dark elf ambassador keeps a front room at Darvar Manor; west of the manor a place is called...

say.line: An ambassador of the Teir'Dal keeps a front room here. The master calls it diplomacy. The staff call it a draft.
say.note: DARV-3: A dark elf ambassador keeps a front room at Darvar Manor; west of the manor a place is called...

say.line: Gnolls from Blackburrow to the north, bandits from the hills to the east. The manor wall is the only quiet line in the Blight.
say.note: DARV-2, QEY-9: The Bandit Hills lie east of the manor's land, the ruins of Al'Karad west of it and Blackburrow...

say.line: Forkwatch is a castle first and a town after. The town grew up because the castle looked lonely.
say.note: FORK-1: Forkwatch is a castle with its guards and citizens and the country round it; gypsies camp north...

say.line: The gypsies camp north of the castle. They travel all over Tunaria. Buy something and they may tell you about a road or two.
say.note: FORK-1, LAND-6: Forkwatch is a castle with its guards and citizens and the country round it; gypsies camp north...

say.line: River pirates hold the Salt Mine east of here. The Blackscourge. They kill whoever they meet. No salt is worth it.
say.note: FORK-2: The Salt Mine lies east of Forkwatch, held by the Blackscourge river pirates; the South...

say.line: Dark Solace sits at the crossroads south of us. Outcasts, every one. They keep to their town and we keep to ours.
say.note: FORK-2, SOLACE-1: The Salt Mine lies east of Forkwatch, held by the Blackscourge river pirates; the South...

say.line: Cultists dug a barrow up the river toward Darvar Manor. They named it for Thenon the Wise. A dead thing keeps the tomb.
say.note: DARV-3: A dark elf ambassador keeps a front room at Darvar Manor; west of the manor a place is called...

say.line: Centaurs live on the southern plains. Proud creatures. Do not offer one an apple. I speak from experience.
say.note: LAND-21: Centaurs live on the southern Plains of Karana.

say.line: Men of Talamir's old regiment wander the land as outlaws. The King of Qeynos cast them out. We do not take them in.
say.note: QEY-3: Talamir's Regiment was an old regiment of the Qeynos Guard that Antonius Bayle II disbanded for...

say.line: The Blackscourge pirates work the river from the Salt Mine. We watch the water as hard as the roads.
say.note: FORK-2: The Salt Mine lies east of Forkwatch, held by the Blackscourge river pirates; the South...

say.line: The castle and all the country round it. That is the whole of our charge, and it is plenty.
say.note: FORK-1: Forkwatch is a castle with its guards and citizens and the country round it; gypsies camp north...

say.line: Fort Seriak is the westernmost post of Neriak. Beyond these walls, nobody bows to the Houses. Yet.
say.note: SERIAK-1: Fort Seriak is a dark elf fort on the shores of Lake Nerius, the westernmost outpost of Neriak...

say.line: The fort stands on the shore of Lake Nerius. The lake is cold, and we share it with a necromancer.
say.note: SERIAK-1: Fort Seriak is a dark elf fort on the shores of Lake Nerius, the westernmost outpost of Neriak...

say.line: Verghest Felstar holds the castle, a human with legions of dead. A human! The insult is worse than the danger.
say.note: SERIAK-2: The human necromancer Verghest Felstar and his undead legions hold Castle Felstar, by Lake...

say.line: Collonridge Cemetery lies south-east of us. Convenient, some say. A fort is never far from needing one.
say.note: SERIAK-1: Fort Seriak is a dark elf fort on the shores of Lake Nerius, the westernmost outpost of Neriak...

say.line: Word from the city is that House U'Dedne totters. Out here we learn who has fallen when the supply wagons change colors.
say.note: NER-2: House Do'Vexis is the first House of Neriak, closest to the royal family and the most...

say.line: Our raiders nearly wiped Feydwell from the map. Nearly. The survivors have been tiresome ever since.
say.note: FAY-2: The small village of Feydwell was almost destroyed by dark elf raiders out of Neriak; its...

say.line: When the last elf of the light has left Tunaria, this fort will be the middle of our lands and not their edge.
say.note: DELF-2: Once the elves are driven from Tunaria the dark elves mean to be the greatest power on it.

say.line: Felstar's dead do not tire and they do not learn. A soldier could envy the first part.
say.note: SERIAK-2: The human necromancer Verghest Felstar and his undead legions hold Castle Felstar, by Lake...

say.line: Clan Gerntar works this mine. Every dwarf here is a cousin. Mind what you say about anyone.
say.note: GERN-1: Gerntar is an active mining operation worked by the dwarves of Clan Gerntar; Head Foreman Zeke...

say.line: The Rustel minotaurs are peaceable enough, left alone. It is their leader, Khelmarak, who is the bad seam in that rock.
say.note: GERN-1: Gerntar is an active mining operation worked by the dwarves of Clan Gerntar; Head Foreman Zeke...

say.line: Head Foreman Zeke wants help with the minotaurs. He has wanted it for some time. Volunteers are thin on the ground.
say.note: GERN-1: Gerntar is an active mining operation worked by the dwarves of Clan Gerntar; Head Foreman Zeke...

say.line: Kelinar is just north of us. Wizards, the mightiest in Tunaria. They do not dig, and they do not care for our noise.
say.note: GERN-2, LAND-13: Kelinar lies north of Gerntar's mines, the gate of Oggok south of them and the Elephant...

say.line: The gate of Oggok lies south of the mines. We sell the ogres nothing. They would not pay, and we could not make them.
say.note: GERN-2: Kelinar lies north of Gerntar's mines, the gate of Oggok south of them and the Elephant...

say.line: King Stormhammer sent out many expeditions looking for ore. Moradhim got the hills of the Serpent's Spine. We got the minotaurs.
say.note: DWARF-1: Almost three centuries ago the dwarven King Stormhammer sent out many expeditions for new...

say.line: A mine without ale is only a hole. Every dwarf of Clan Gerntar believes that, and digs accordingly.
say.note: DWARF-3: Dwarves do not count their height a lack (a kneecap breaks as well as a nose); every dwarf...

say.line: If the minotaurs give trouble, look for Khelmarak. The rest are quiet beasts without him.
say.note: GERN-1: Gerntar is an active mining operation worked by the dwarves of Clan Gerntar; Head Foreman Zeke...

say.line: You dreamed of this village before you ever saw it. All peoples do. That is how we knew you would come.
say.note: DREAD-4: Graumord is a nightmarish village of lost souls, known only in the terrifying dreams of all...

say.line: We are the lost souls of Graumord. Nobody remembers arriving. Nobody remembers anywhere else.
say.note: DREAD-4: Graumord is a nightmarish village of lost souls, known only in the terrifying dreams of all...

say.line: Some say this isle is the gift of the Faceless to his faithful dead. Some say it is a snare. From inside, there is no difference.
say.note: DREAD-1: The Faceless has more realms than his Plane of Fear, and the Isle of Dread is one: a reward for...

say.line: The statue of Cazic-Thule stands on this isle, his foothold out of the Plane of Fear. Do not look for its face. It has none.
say.note: DREAD-3: A statue of Cazic-Thule stands on the Isle of Dread, a foothold on Tunaria from the Plane of...

say.line: Adventurers come for the trials of the Faceless. Only the worthy are meant to pass. The rest stay with us.
say.note: DREAD-3: A statue of Cazic-Thule stands on the Isle of Dread, a foothold on Tunaria from the Plane of...

say.line: Now and then a sailor washes up on Tunaria, raving. That is all the mainland knows of us. It is enough.
say.note: DREAD-2: All that is known of the isle comes from the ramblings of madmen washed ashore after days lost...

say.line: The things that walk these hills were made by the Lord of Fear for his own plane. This isle is near enough to it for them.
say.note: LAND-29, DREAD-1: The creatures of the Plane of Sky are majestic and powerful; the dreadful creatures Cazic-Thule...

say.line: I keep watch. Against what, I no longer know. The Faceless has more servants here than I have arrows.
say.note: DREAD-3: A statue of Cazic-Thule stands on the Isle of Dread, a foothold on Tunaria from the Plane of...

say.line: Everything taken out of Takish'Hiz comes through this port on its way to Neriak. We count it in. Somebody else counts it again.
say.note: HAZ-1: Hazinak is a dark elf outpost and port, the staging area for shipping the artifacts of...

say.line: Hazinak is an outpost, not a home. One serves here, and waits to be recalled. Some wait a long time.
say.note: HAZ-1: Hazinak is a dark elf outpost and port, the staging area for shipping the artifacts of...

say.line: The Slith'Tar hives lie west of the walls. Half-witted vermin that hate everything living. Do not wander that way.
say.note: HAZ-2: Guk lies south of Hazinak and the hives of the Slith'Tar west of it; the Slith'Tar are an evil...

say.line: Guk is south of here. The frogloks have retaken its caves from the trolls. Our allies sulk about it loudly.
say.note: HAZ-2, TROLL-1: Guk lies south of Hazinak and the hives of the Slith'Tar west of it; the Slith'Tar are an evil...

say.line: General Torvek holds what is left of Takish'Hiz. The last elves there still fight him for vengeance. It slows the looting.
say.note: TOMB-10: Dark elf forces under General Torvek hold what was Takish'Hiz; the last of its elves fight on...

say.line: Human nomads loot the old elven catacombs as well. They take scraps. Neriak takes the rest.
say.note: TOMB-5: The dark elves looted and defiled the city, and its treasure was, and still is, shipped to...

say.line: Necromancy won us Takish'Hiz. The dead did the fighting, and the living do the hauling. A sensible division.
say.note: DELF-1: The dark elves poured up out of the Underfoot onto Tunaria, and by necromancy have just won...

say.line: Every crate on that dock is bound for Neriak. If one goes missing, so does a guard. I do not mean to be that guard.
say.note: HAZ-1: Hazinak is a dark elf outpost and port, the staging area for shipping the artifacts of...

say.line: Skeleton pirates hold the island off our coast, captain and all. They do not drink tea. It would run straight through.
say.note: TEA-1: People live and work at Muniel's Tea Garden, south along the coast from Freeport; skeleton...

say.line: The Deathfist citadel is the next country west of us. The biggest horde of orcs in the world, and so close. More tea?
say.note: TEA-2, LAND-23: The Deathfist citadel is the zone west of Muniel's Tea Garden, the desert of north-western Ro...

say.line: South of the garden are the ruins of Al Farak. Guests ask about them. We advise the mint and a different subject.
say.note: TEA-2: The Deathfist citadel is the zone west of Muniel's Tea Garden, the desert of north-western Ro...

say.line: Sand giants walk the Desert of Ro. They look slow. Do not let that comfort you. So does a landslide.
say.note: TEA-3: Sand giants walk the Desert of Ro, and a desert dragon, Skahyir.

say.line: There is a dragon in the desert, they say. Skahyir. It has never come for tea. We have never invited it.
say.note: TEA-3: Sand giants walk the Desert of Ro, and a desert dragon, Skahyir.

say.line: We see them pass sometimes, the ones the desert has driven mad. We leave a cup out. It is usually gone by morning.
say.note: FREE-8: The northern Desert of Ro begins in the zone south of Freeport; humans who wander into the...

say.line: The Nasehir rob and kill whoever crosses their sand. The Taksehir are at war with them, and are rather better guests.
say.note: OASIS-1: The Nasehir are aggressive desert nomads who live by robbing and killing whoever passes; the...

say.line: Deathfist to the west, the desert to the north, pirates off the shore. We guard a tea garden. Somebody thinks highly of the tea.
say.note: TEA-1, TEA-2: People live and work at Muniel's Tea Garden, south along the coast from Freeport; skeleton...

say.line: Do not go into the Unkempt Wood. We tell everyone. Some listen. The others we do not see again.
say.note: MURNF-1: Murnf is a farming village on the edge of the Unkempt Wood; its simple folk warn people not to...

say.line: We farm right to the edge of the Unkempt and not one furrow farther. My grandfather drew that line. I do not cross it.
say.note: MURNF-1: Murnf is a farming village on the edge of the Unkempt Wood; its simple folk warn people not to...

say.line: They say a dwarf smith lives alone in the Unkempt. Grim Brellhand, the Last Smith. A legend. I would not go in to check.
say.note: MURNF-3: The Last Smith, Grim Brellhand, is a legendary dwarven smith who lives in seclusion in the...

say.line: The old treants of the Unkempt drive out whoever walks in. Tree, wolf or bear, something in there will not have you.
say.note: WERE-20: The Werebear Witchking and his cultists camp near Zentar's Keep, where werewolves prowl too...

say.line: The wolfmen in the wood carry a silver crescent on a black circle. If you are near enough to see it, it is too late to run.
say.note: WERE-3: Levandius has lived in the Unkempt Forest for centuries, fighting all who trespass; his blood...

say.line: The wood has been restless of late. They say its old druid is dying and his heirs are at each other's throats.
say.note: WERE-5: Wegadas is dying, and his heirs are at war for the leadership of the Unkempt; the Night Reapers...

say.line: Surefall Glade is south of us. The druids there understand woods. Even they do not tell us ours is safe.
say.note: SURE-3, SURE-1: Murnf lies north of Surefall Glade and the Fog Marsh south of it; Wymondham, to the east, is a...

say.line: When the moon is full, every door in Murnf is barred by dusk. The watch stands indoors those nights. So should you.
say.note: WERE-7: Wolfweres have no human form and no mastery of themselves; when the moon of Drinal is full they...

say.line: The Nasehir live by the knife. The Taksehir are at war with them, and so are we, in our way. Ask a gypsy who is winning.
say.note: OASIS-1: The Nasehir are aggressive desert nomads who live by robbing and killing whoever passes; the...

say.line: West of the water lies Tak'Xiv, where the last somber elves hold on. They buy little and say less.
say.note: OASIS-2, TOMB-10: Tak'Xiv lies west of Oasis, the Great Waste east of it, the Eternal Desert north of it and the...

say.line: The Sea of Lions is south of here. Nobody has ever told me where the lions went.
say.note: OASIS-2: Tak'Xiv lies west of Oasis, the Great Waste east of it, the Eternal Desert north of it and the...

say.line: There is a grove in this desert that never died. A sacred tree keeps it, and beasts keep the tree. The caravans go around.
say.note: TOMB-11: A sacred tree, guarded by beasts, still keeps one grove of the old forest alive in the middle...

say.line: All of this was forest once, the Elddar. A god's jealousy made it sand. We draw our water from what he missed.
say.note: TOMB-3, TOMB-12: When the forest of Elddar fell to the burning sands, most of the elves of Takish'Hiz left...

say.line: The plunder of Takish'Hiz goes out by the wagonload, bound for Neriak. The ruins are not far. The dust reaches us first.
say.note: TOMB-5, OASIS-2: The dark elves looted and defiled the city, and its treasure was, and still is, shipped to...

say.line: The Deathfist live on the caravans that cross the Desert of Ro. Every caravan master here has a scar and a story.
say.note: LAND-23: The Deathfist are the largest horde of orcs known in the world, and live by raiding and...

say.line: When a sand giant crosses the dunes you feel it in your feet before you see it.
say.note: TEA-3: Sand giants walk the Desert of Ro, and a desert dragon, Skahyir.

say.line: Nasehir cutthroats rob and kill whoever passes their way. They have not passed this wall. Not while I have it.
say.note: OASIS-1: The Nasehir are aggressive desert nomads who live by robbing and killing whoever passes; the...

say.line: Wyndhaven is the northern edge of the King's country. The King's law comes this far. It arrives tired.
say.note: WYND-1: Wyndhaven is a town of shady humans on the northern edge of the Qeynos city-state; Bogman...

say.line: Bogman is north of us. Northmen, of a sort, in a ramshackle village. We get on. Nobody asks questions in either place.
say.note: WYND-1: Wyndhaven is a town of shady humans on the northern edge of the Qeynos city-state; Bogman...

say.line: The elves keep an outpost at Mariel, north of here. The last they have in the west. They look at the sea a great deal.
say.note: WYND-2: Mariel, the zone north of Wyndhaven, is the only elven outpost left on the western side of...

say.line: Northmen fish out of Binshore, down on Whale Hill. Big, loud and honest. They find us odd.
say.note: WYND-2: Mariel, the zone north of Wyndhaven, is the only elven outpost left on the western side of...

say.line: A new king in Qeynos. He will want to know what goes on up here. We wish him patience.
say.note: QEY-1: Qeynos is the greatest human city on Tunaria, ruled by the lately crowned Antonius Bayle II.

say.line: Crethley Manor is a ruin with a vampire in it, they say. Nobody here has been to check. We are shady, not stupid.
say.note: QEY-8: Crethley Manor, north-east of Qeynos, is an ancient ruined mansion rumored to be haunted by a...

say.line: The rat family has friends in the outlying villages. I am not saying here. I am not saying anything.
say.note: WERE-16: The Topi di Ombra are a powerful family of wererats under Yindrius, chiefly in Qeynos, Neriak...

say.line: I keep the peace in Wyndhaven. It is a flexible sort of peace. Do not stretch it.
say.note: WYND-1: Wyndhaven is a town of shady humans on the northern edge of the Qeynos city-state; Bogman...

say.line: Zentar built this fortress, the knight of darkness the legends tell of. The legends are kind. Stone tells it truer.
say.note: ZENT-1: Zentar's Keep is a fortress built by Zentar, the legendary knight of darkness; Zentar Reese is...

say.line: Zentar Reese commands here. The man, the myth and the legend, and he will tell you so himself.
say.note: ZENT-1: Zentar's Keep is a fortress built by Zentar, the legendary knight of darkness; Zentar Reese is...

say.line: North of the keep is Permafrost, the ice dragon's country. We are the warm country, by her reckoning.
say.note: ZENT-2, LAND-9: Permafrost lies north of Zentar's Keep, the northern Unkempt east of it and Bogman south of it...

say.line: Great ice worms roam the snow north and east of the walls. A cook in Wyndhaven pays for the meat. Each to his taste.
say.note: ZENT-2: Permafrost lies north of Zentar's Keep, the northern Unkempt east of it and Bogman south of it...

say.line: The Witchking camps near the keep with his cultists. He wants the Unkempt for himself. He may have it, if he leaves us the road.
say.note: WERE-20, WERE-9: The Werebear Witchking and his cultists camp near Zentar's Keep, where werewolves prowl too...

say.line: Werewolves prowl near the keep most nights. We do not hunt them. They thin out the visitors.
say.note: WERE-20: The Werebear Witchking and his cultists camp near Zentar's Keep, where werewolves prowl too...

say.line: Bogman lies south of us. Rough folk in a ramshackle village. They sell to us and do not ask what for.
say.note: ZENT-2, WYND-1: Permafrost lies north of Zentar's Keep, the northern Unkempt east of it and Bogman south of it...

say.line: You stand in the keep of Zentar Reese. Whatever law you kept in the south, leave it at the gate.
say.note: ZENT-1: Zentar's Keep is a fortress built by Zentar, the legendary knight of darkness; Zentar Reese is...

say.line: They say only the rats outnumber us humans. I have seen the rats of a city. It is closer than you would think.
say.note: HUMAN-4: Humans are the most numerous people of Norrath (some say only rats outnumber them)...

say.line: Every human comes of Northman stock, if you go back far enough. I feel it most when the ale comes round.
say.note: BARB-5: The barbarians are the hardy stock of Northmen from which all humans came.

say.line: A human will take up any trade there is. Except shaman. We never did get the knack of it.

say.line: The Marr twins made the Northmen, and we came of the Northmen. So I count the twins as family, a few times removed.

say.line: Most peoples make an elf welcome, I find. Only the dark elves and the trolls would sooner see me on a spit.

say.line: When the elves of the light are driven from Tunaria, there will be one great power on it. Learn our courtesies now.
say.note: DELF-2: Once the elves are driven from Tunaria the dark elves mean to be the greatest power on it.

say.line: You will have seen elven treasures for sale in this place. Think of them as ours. We took them, after all.

say.line: Building a good contraption is as important as saving the world. Often it is the same job.

say.line: A dwarf laughs easy and forgives hard. Stay on the laughing side.

say.line: We High Men are proud of the mind and careless of the body. A body is only what carries the mind to the library.

say.line: I am told we have few friends outside our own people. I have not found the lack troubling.

say.note: LAND-26: The Seisen are a militaristic society of warmongering monks who worship Rallos Zek.

say.line: There is a guild of actors on the roads, the Actour's Guild. Nobody knows what they are really about. That may be the performance.
say.note: LAND-27: The Actour's Guild is a mysterious guild of actors whose motives are unknown.

say.line: The magician Saerk keeps a tower with his staff and his minions. He does not take callers. The minions make that clear.
say.note: LAND-28: Saerk is a magician who keeps a tower with his minions and his staff.

say.line: The Stone Watchers take no side in anything. Not the elves', not the Teir'Dal's, not yours.
say.note: LAND-22: The Stone Watchers are a wholly neutral people.

say.line: The Evil Eyes have a prophet, Xorbb, and he has thralls. They call themselves the Eye. Try not to catch it.
say.note: LAND-16: The thralls of Xorbb, the prophet of the Evil Eyes, are called the Eye.

say.line: There is a cave so full of snakes that folk think some unknown snake-god is worshipped there. Nobody has stayed long enough to ask.
say.note: LAND-17: Deep in a cave full of snakes, some think, an unknown snake-god is worshipped.
